name: aigc
headline: aigc intelligent agent platform
short_description: AIGC 智能 Agent 平台 integrates Claude AI models to provide intelligent, scenario-based AI solutions. It offers multi-tenancy, session management, and skill extension for enterprise operations. Connects to Python and React workflows.
author: xiaoyuge886

sections.overview:
AIGC is an intelligent agent platform built on Claude AI models that provides scenario-based AI solutions for enterprise operations. It features a visual Skill Galaxy system with 15+ professional skills spanning data analysis, code development, UI/UX design, and document management. The platform includes intelligent scenario matching that automatically selects the best AI configuration for user needs, plus comprehensive multi-user session management with conversation history and feedback. Organizations can customize AI behavior, tool permissions, and system prompts through an admin dashboard, while the front-end and back-end separation architecture supports integration with Python and React workflows.
Automated data analysis with SQL optimization and ECharts visualization
Code generation and development assistance with frontend design to code conversion
Technical document and PowerPoint presentation auto-generation
Multi-user team collaboration with persistent session management
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/xiaoyuge886/aigc`
sections.usage:
```
Design an intelligent automation workflow for [SCENARIO] using AIGC智能Agent平台. Include the following components: 1) A Python script that handles [DATA_PROCESSING_TASK] with error handling for [EDGE_CASES], 2) A React component that visualizes [DATA_OUTPUT] with interactive filters for [USER_NEEDS], and 3) A Claude AI agent that monitors the workflow and triggers corrective actions when [FAILURE_CONDITIONS] are detected. Provide the complete code structure with clear documentation for each component.
```
